specification.label: 60% US Equities / 40% Intermediate-Term Treasuries

instruments.SPY: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (US large-cap equities)
instruments.IEF: iShares 7-10 Year Treasury Bond ETF (intermediate-term US Treasuries)

specification.not_a_market_portfolio: A fixed reference mix of two of the evaluation assets. It is not a neutral, broad-market or policy benchmark: it holds no corporate credit, no long-duration Treasuries and no cash, and it is closer to the Deterministic and Causal RAG universes (SPY/IEF/LQD) than to JEV's (SPY/TLT).

rules.evaluation_dates: identical to the systems': decision at 20:00 ET on the last common trading day of each month (SPY, IEF, LQD, TLT calendars)
rules.execution: back to 60/40 at the close of the first common trading day after month-end; held to the next such close; weights drift with returns in between
rules.transaction_costs: the shared 5 bp per dollar traded against the drifted weights; the first month starts from cash
rules.dividends: distribution-adjusted closing prices from the pinned, hash-verified inputs (total return)
rules.return_calculation: monthly net total return over the exact holding period; excess return over DTB4WK accrued over the same dates; all metrics by the shared evaluator

specification.role: A common passive reference for evaluation and display only: one reference line for all three primary approaches and secondary, descriptive comparisons. It is not a fully neutral portfolio and not a direct measure of model skill. It never enters the primary Holm family, never redefines the primary endpoint and is never an input to any system.
specification.decomposition: Accounting decomposition, not a causal attribution: CER(system) - CER(common) = [CER(system) - CER(own native benchmark)] (labelled 'decisions') + [CER(own native benchmark) - CER(common)] (labelled 'benchmark mix'). Exact by construction.
reporting: One common-benchmark line on the main dashboard chart.
Comparisons with each approach's native benchmark in the approach's detail view.
The decisions / benchmark-mix split shown and described as an accounting decomposition, not a causal attribution.
Results against the common benchmark reported whatever they show.
selection_rationale: Both instruments passed Stage 2 gate 5 (distribution adjustment, C1-C6) over 2014-02..2023-02-01; TLT's gate 5 result (FAIL on C2 preserved) is still awaiting team sign-off, so the reference line does not depend on it.
IEF's interest-rate sensitivity (7-10 year Treasuries) is closer to the bond sleeve of a conventional 60/40 than TLT's (20+ year Treasuries).
No single fixed mix is neutral across the approaches' universes; this one overlaps the Deterministic and Causal RAG universes, and the attribution makes that visible.
specification.information_seen_before_selection: Development-period (2019-03..2022-12) figures for 60/40 SPY/TLT, 60/40 SPY/IEF and 45/35/20 SPY/IEF/LQD were reviewed. No protected-window data were seen.

timing.decision_day: last common trading day of the calendar month
timing.execution: close of the first common trading day after month-end
timing.holding: to the close of the first common trading day after the next month-end
timing.cash: DTB4WK quote at entry accrued over exact calendar days (Stage 2 rule)

fingerprint_definition: SHA-256 of canonical JSON of common_benchmark fields id, weights, rebalance, rules, role, decomposition plus inherited calendar_assets, timing, costs, metrics (framework/benchmark.py _fingerprint). The evaluator refuses a frozen benchmark whose fingerprint differs.
specification_block_definition: SHA-256 of canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of the complete common_benchmark block as frozen, including its freeze entry.

proposal.changes_at_freeze: Only the wording of 'role' and of the decomposition field (renamed from 'attribution') changed, as required by the approval conditions; 'reporting' was added (outside the fingerprint). Weights, rebalancing, rules and every inherited shared setting are identical, so no number changes.

unchanged: All original strategies and their decision records
The three pre-registered primary pairwise net-CER contrasts and their Holm family
Windows, costs, cash rate and metrics
change_policy: Any change requires a new framework-config version, a documented reason and a new approval; none is permitted once the protected window has been opened.
